nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=28 beats='Tomas and his grandmother Abuela Rosa spread rolls of colored paper, thin wooden dowels, and spools of string across the kitchen table the day before the Spring Kite Festival. The windsock outside keeps twisting from north to south, and Abuela reminds Tomas that a good kite maker always tests a design before trusting it.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='Abuela unrolls three sketches on the table: a swooping bird, a sturdy box, and a long dragon with a rippling tail. She asks Tomas which design to build and test first, since the changing wind means the kite he starts with will need real testing before tomorrow.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Tomas cuts curved wings from sky blue paper while Abuela lashes two dowels into a cross frame for the bird kite; outside, the wind gusts hard enough to rattle the porch chimes.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='In the gusty backyard the bird kite dips, spins, and nose dives twice before Tomas catches it; Abuela suggests either tying on a longer paper tail for balance or carrying the kite to a different, calmer spot to test.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Tomas braids three paper streamers into a tail and knots it to the spine of the kite; Abuela says it is worth testing on the big open lawn tomorrow.'>>

choices.label: Test it on the open lawn

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='By the garden fence the wind settles into a steady push and the bird kite lifts clean and level, but a sudden gust off the roof could still snap it sideways. Tomas notices the calm holds near the fence, while past the fence the wind still swings wildly. Abuela asks whether to trust this calm corner for tomorrow, or head back inside to strengthen the frame first since festival mornings are rarely this calm.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Back in the workshop Tomas reinforces the frame with a second dowel, but the extra weight is ready too late; by the time it is strong enough the festival gates have closed for the day, and Tomas and Abuela agree the sturdier bird kite will fly first next spring instead.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Tomas glues four straight dowels into a square frame while Abuela stretches yellow paper tight across it for the box kite; the wind outside keeps flipping from a push to a lull.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='By the shed the box kite jerks sideways and one paper corner peels loose in a strong gust; Abuela offers to either reglue the sagging corner now or carry the kite up to the open hill where the wind runs steadier.'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Tomas presses fresh glue along the loose paper corner and holds it flat until it dries; Abuela says a patched box kite still deserves a test by the garden fence.'>>

choices.label: Test it by the garden fence

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='On the open hill the box kite catches a long steady current and hums as it climbs, but a line of trees at the edge of the hill could catch it if the wind veers. Tomas feels the string tug hard and steady while Abuela watches the treeline. She asks whether to keep flying high on the hill or reel it in now while it is still safely overhead.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Tomas reels the box kite in just as the wind veers toward the trees, and though it never flies again that afternoon, Abuela says a kite brought home safe can always fly another day; they patch the corner properly that evening for next time.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Tomas paints a fierce red face on the round paper head of the dragon kite while Abuela knots six ribbon segments into its long rippling tail; the wind keeps gusting in short unpredictable bursts.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='Along the driveway the long tail of the dragon kite drags and tangles on the ground before a gust finally lifts it crooked; Abuela suggests either shortening the tail so it lifts faster or waiting for a longer, steadier gust to try again.'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Tomas snips two ribbon segments off the tangled tail, and the dragon kite lifts lighter and faster right there; Abuela says it deserves a test on the big open lawn.'>>

choices.label: Test it on the open lawn

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Waiting at the end of the driveway, Tomas feels a long steady gust roll in and the dragon kite rises smoothly, tail rippling like the spine of a real dragon; but the gust could die out again any second the way the others did. Abuela asks whether to launch higher right now while the gust holds, or land it safely and wait for a stronger gust before trying again.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Tomas lands the dragon kite safely and waits, but the steadier gust never returns before dinner; Abuela wraps the tail carefully for tomorrow and promises the festival field always has more wind to offer than one driveway ever could.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='On the big open lawn the wind settles into a long steady roll with plenty of room on every side. Tomas is not sure whether to linger and watch how long the calm holds, or carry the kite straight over to the judges table while the wind is still perfect.'>>

choices.label: Watch and wait for festival morning
Carry it straight to the judges

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Tomas waits and watches the lawn wind hold steady minute after minute, and Abuela marks the spot with a stick for festival morning.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=47 beats='Festival morning the marked lawn spot holds its steady wind just as promised; the kite that started there climbs smooth and high, and a judge writes it down as the steadiest flyer of the whole festival.'>>

ending.title: The Steadiest Flyer on the Lawn

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Tomas carries the kite straight to the judges while the lawn wind still holds; it lifts clean on the first try in front of the whole crowd, and Abuela beams as the judges applaud.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='By the garden fence the breeze stays gentle and even, easy on a patched or newly tailed kite. Tomas wonders whether to leave it right there overnight for an early festival test, or carry it home first to show the family how well it flies.'>>

choices.label: Leave it by the fence overnight
Take it home to show the family

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Tomas leaves the kite resting by the fence overnight, and Abuela checks the knots twice before they head inside for supper.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=47 beats='Morning finds the fence side kite ready and waiting exactly where they left it; the gentle breeze carries it into easy, even circles all through the festival, calm from first launch to last.'>>

ending.title: Easy Circles From Start to Finish

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='The family passes the kite around the kitchen table that evening, admiring the tail and the patched corner; it never gets tested again before the festival, but everyone agrees it looks ready enough to try tomorrow.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='High on the open hill the wind runs long and strong, pulling the kite up past the treeline with room still to climb. Tomas has to decide whether to chase the wind even higher right now, or land it carefully and save that good height for the festival tomorrow.'>>

choices.label: Land it and save the height

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Tomas lets the line out further and the kite climbs past the treetops, humming in the strong hill wind while Abuela counts the seconds it holds.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=47 beats='At the festival the hill wind returns just as strong, and the kite climbs higher than anything else in the field, so high that a younger flyer asks Tomas to teach her the trick.'>>

ending.title: Higher Than Anything in the Field

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=45 beats='Tomas lands the kite carefully at its best height and Abuela ties off the line; next morning the same hill wind lifts it straight back to that same great height in front of the whole festival crowd.'>>

ending.title: Back to That Same Great Height
